name: KBC Corporation, Ltd.
summary: KBC Corporation, Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of carbon-based composite materials and products in China and internationally. The company offers crucibles, guide tubes, insulation cylinders, heaters, and other products; carbon ceramic composite materials and their derivatives, friction materials; artificial graphite, porous carbon, and thermal fields for the preparation of lithium battery positive and negative electrode materials; and carbon paper for gas diffusion layers, and gas diffusion layer materials.
